extra.message: User-controlled request body or blob query parameter is passed to pickle.loads(). Pickle deserialization can execute attacker-controlled code.

cwe: CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')

extra.message: The patient_identity_ping_342 endpoint accepts handle and channel from the request and queues an identity-related action without authentication or authorization checks.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: A hardcoded fallback Django SECRET_KEY is present. If deployed without DJANGO_SECRET_KEY set, attackers with source access can forge or tamper with signed Django data.

SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE and CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE default to false unless environment variables are set, allowing cookies to be sent over plaintext HTTP in default deployments.
